psychological_meaning: Rich Gold evokes feelings of luxury, prosperity, and sophistication. It combines the warmth and energy of yellow with the grounded stability of brown, creating a sense of confident abundance and established success. This color is often associated with high-end brands and items, suggesting quality and lasting value.
